scoring: Each of 15 scenarios awards one point for the objective decision and one for the evidence reason: 30 points per form.
mastery: Both forms require 30/30, all 15 objectives, and a closed-note explanation of both domains.
status_rule: Ready requires passing evidence; confidence is recorded separately. Any miss sets that objective to remediate. Unattempted means not_yet_assessed.
remediation: Return to the mapped prerequisite lesson for the missed objective, produce the named artifact or explanation, then take a fresh scenario.
warning: Course-authored review scenarios are not Microsoft exam questions and passing this gate does not guarantee an exam result.
